notes: COMBO CARD — TALL FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1098 crop) on the red Dark Effect frame. Top to bottom: (1) TITLE BAR: green-swirl Effect disc at left (as printed); title '•A Sith’s Plans' (curly apostrophe); destiny 3 in the black hole. (2) LORE BOX (black): 'The Imperial fleet keeps a tight grip on the systems / under its control. Abuses and excesses by local citizens / are not tolerated.' — first line indented; same wording as the printed card (wiki lore correct). Right of the lore box: the Special Edition expansion sphere (white starburst on gold, silver rim) as printed — expansion, not {ovs}. (3) ART WINDOW: blank white on the slip (white patch overruns the frame's right edge in the crop — crop artefact) → printed art from the base scan, no slip art. Copyright not printed on the slip. (4) Banner EFFECT; black text box, 6 lines, ending with the red circle-slash A (Immune to Alter) → {alter}; '▼' before 'a non-war room'. No icon column; diamond '17' VS17 marker at the bottom-right (not an icon). (5) Bottom strip: caption '•Oppressive Enforcement (V)', number 11. Tall slip: banner higher by ~55 slip px than the printed card (and the text box taller). CHANGES vs Decipher Oppressive Enforcement (Special Edition, SE-D-oppressiveenforcement.gif 350 px): title •Oppressive Enforcement → •A Sith’s Plans; destiny 4 → 3; game text replaced (printed: 'Deploy on your side of table. Your Imperial capital starships are each destiny +1. Your Immediate Effects may deploy for free. Whenever opponent cancels your card with Sense or Alter, place that canceled card in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)'); lore, disc, ring, banner unchanged. Wiki stub garbles the ▼ as 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' and writes 'Immune to Alter.' for the icon. Base page: the Special Edition Effect 'Oppressive Enforcement' (not the Reflections III Defensive Shield 'Oppressive Enforcement (Dark)'). Copyright SE 1998 line by set (350 px, not legible). Modern: Virtual Block 5 'A Sith’s Plans' (VB5-D-asithsplans-pre.gif, 350) — same text as this slip, Oppressive Enforcement art, destiny 3; the wiki page 'A Sith's Plans' is that VB5 card.
